Hey, I’m Nathaniel. I recently moved to Brisbane for footy and to focus on my Uni. I’m originally from South Australia and looking to settle into a good place from April 1st or generally any day of April.
I’m a pretty easygoing and respectful person. I keep my space clean, I’m organised, and I’m mindful of others I live with. I’m not a big partier, most of my time is spent training, studying, or just relaxing.
Outside of uni and sport, I like staying active, going to the gym, and just chilling out. I’m social and friendly but also respect people’s space and downtime.
I’m looking for a place with good vibes, clean shared spaces, and housemates who are respectful and easy to get along with. Ideally somewhere I can focus on my goals but still feel comfortable at home.
